column3: “Past” specifies the wonders, and “Nebuchadnezzar” names the unstated subject of withdrawal.
“Against you” and “their forces” specify the direction of the weapons and the referent of those gathered.
“Officers” renders servants; “put them to the sword” replaces striking with the mouth of the sword.
“Surrenders” renders falling over to the Chaldeans; “life” renders soul in the spoil image.
“Tell” supplies a verb before the address.
“Every” specifies the morning; “their” replaces “your” in the phrase about evil deeds.
“Above” and “atop” specify locations given as inhabitant of the valley and rock of the plain.
“Your forest” replaces “her forest”; the final surroundings are also referred to as hers.
